fn MinimumMoves(n: Int, k: Int) -> Int
  requires (2 <= n)
  requires (n <= 5000)
  requires (1 <= k)
  requires (k <= n)
  ensures (result == (if ((k == 1) or (k == n)) then (3 * n) else ((3 * n) + (if ((k - 1) <= (n - k)) then (k - 1) else (n - k)))))
  ensures (result > 0)
  effects pure
  example (MinimumMoves(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
